land-coin.name: land-coin
land-coin.description: One cell of a respin: a coin lands with a fixed chance and, if the cell was empty, stays there with a drawn prize.

respin.name: respin
respin.description: One respin: each of the 15 cells may receive a coin, and the respins are restored or used up.

hold-and-spin.name: hold-and-spin
hold-and-spin.description: Hold & Spin: held coins stay while the other cells respin. A new coin restores the 3 respins; the feature ends when they run out or the board is full, and pays every held coin.

board.name: board

coin-prize.name: coin-prize
coin-prize.description: Gives one cell its coin value: the drawn prize × the stake if the cell shows a coin, nothing otherwise.

coin-prizes.name: coin-prizes
coin-prizes.description: Every coin on the board carries a prize: one prize is drawn per cell, and the 15 cells are valued one after another.
